messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT P12345 fired for GPU memory pressure in infer-west2a-pool-7 at 2025-11-03T04:00:01Z. Symptoms: nvml OOM count spike, eviction events. Link: https://pagerduty.company/p/INC12345
pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @emma-oncall, @oncall-sre. PagerDuty incident: P12345 - GPU memory pressure (severity: P1)
emma-oncall: ACK. Jumping in. quick status: are we seeing OOMs across the whole pool or a few hosts?
raj-sre: looking at node metrics now — gpunode-27 and gpunode-29 show nvml_alloc failures and repeated OOMs. nvml dmesg shows: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:07:00): 79, GPU memory access error on device 0
[ 1234.568123] cuda: cublasAlloc failed: out of memory
```
Seems correlated with long KV cache warmups from batch jobs.
emma-oncall: thanks. Kicking reroute for that pool, starting drain on gpunode-29 to stop new allocations.
emma-oncall: ```bash
fleetctl drain gpunode-29 --reason "oom spike" --now
kubectl cordon gpunode-29
```
maria-ml: we just saw a few customer requests fall back to CPU model variant causing 2-3x latency on some endpoints. Not seeing lost requests yet but latency spikes reported. Which customers are impacted?
lisa-support: I can pull the customer-facing traffic map. Tentatively affected customers: search-saas-prod and chat-consumer-eu. I'll prepare a status page blurb.
tom-platform: Can we temporarily widen the fallback-eligibility to allow smaller quantized model on this pool to reduce pressure? That would reduce GPU mem by ~40%.
emma-oncall: good idea. maria, can you deploy the q4-compact variant as fallback for infer-west2a for the next 30m?
maria-ml: deploying canary of q4-compact to routing group now. Patching canary route: route-config: infer-west2a -> prefer q4-compact on mem>80%
raj-sre: started restart of inference-worker on gpunode-27 to reclaim memory. Observed immediate drop in nvml errors on 27 after restart, 29 still noisy.
emma-oncall: handing primary incident ownership to @raj-sre to continue node-level mitigations and heal. I'll stay nearby for customer comms.
raj-sre: taking over. current plan: keep draining 29 until stable, move any long-running batch jobs off the pool, and increase prefetch backoff on kvcache for the pool. Rolling restart of pool controllers scheduled in 5m.
lisa-support: status page draft posted: https://status.company/incidents/P12345. Noting degraded performance for two customers and our mitigation steps.
incidents-bot: Auto-check at +5m: nvml OOM rate decreased 72% after drain and q4-compact rollout. Monitoring for recurrence.
emma-oncall: great. if OOMs trend down, we'll keep pool cordoned for 15m then uncordon and observe. If it spikes again, we'll escalate to infra eng for allocator hotfix.
raj-sre: noted. will send a follow-up runbook summary after stabilization. tagging: @maria-ml for rollback plan if q4-compact causes quality regressions.
maria-ml: observed no immediate regressed outputs on sampled evals. ready to roll back if customers flag issues.
emma-oncall: thanks team. closing active paging for now; leaving incident open for after-action. :white_check_mark:
